traits.name: Deep Breath
traits.text: A lizardfolk scout can hold their breath for 150 rounds (15 minutes).

traits.name: Hidden Movement
traits.text: If the lizardfolk scout starts its turn undetected by a creature or hidden from it, that creature is flat-footed against the scout's attacks until the end of the scout's turn.

traits.name: Giant Centipede Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 1d6 (1d6) poison damage (1 round) Stage 2 1d8 (1d8) poison damage and flat-footed (1 round) Stage 3 1d12 (1d12) poison damage, clumsy 1, and flat-footed (1 round)

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The lizardfolk scout deals an extra 1d6 (1d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

traits.name: Terrain Advantage
traits.text: Non-lizardfolk creatures in difficult terrain and non-lizardfolk creatures that are in water and lack a swim Speed are flat-footed to the lizardfolk defender.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: blowgun (10 darts, 1 of which is coated with giant centipede venom);

actions.text: ⬻ blowgun +8 (agile, nonlethal, range increment 20 feet, reload 1); Damage 1 piercing plus giant centipede venom
